name: Guarantee
definition: Partial or full coverage of amounts by a party other than the debtor.

GuaranteeType.name: Guarantee Type
GuaranteeType.definition: Specifies the type of security granted by an organisation with the role as 'guarantor', for example, suretyship.

CoveredPercentage.name: Covered Percentage
CoveredPercentage.definition: Amount covered by the guarantee, expressed as a percentage.

ExcessAmount.name: Excess Amount
ExcessAmount.definition: Amount not covered by the guarantee.

EffectivePeriod.name: Effective Period
EffectivePeriod.definition: Period during which the guarantee is valid.

Document.name: Document
Document.definition: Document which contains the description of the guarantee.

GuaranteedTrade.name: Guaranteed Trade
GuaranteedTrade.definition: Trade which is partially or fully covered by a guarantee.

GuaranteePartyRole.name: Guarantee Party Role
GuaranteePartyRole.definition: Specifies the roles played by a party in the context of guarantees.
